description: Reusable authored-pose direction for wizard player identities. Identity details always come from player-variants.json and the staged portrait; this profile supplies only class motion and continuity rules.

style.authority: Pixel density, outline language, compact tactical proportions, lighting, and material rendering only. The style image must never override the selected identity portrait or player metadata.

identity.motionStyle: flowing, measured, graceful, scholarly, and deliberate, with readable anticipation and follow-through
identity.equipmentRule: Keep the authoritative portrait's wizard equipment design and count consistent in every pose. Show exactly one primary staff or focus when the portrait contains one; never duplicate it.
identity.magicRule: Use the identity portrait's established magical palette. Effects stay compact and secondary so that hands, arms, equipment, and body mechanics remain readable.

promptTemplates.reference: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: canonical full-body game character reference for a 16-bit fantasy tactical RPG. Image 1 is the authoritative {{displayName}} identity portrait; Image 2 is the approved full-body pixel-art style and proportion reference only. Player identity metadata: {{visualTraits}}. Create one complete head-to-toe {{displayName}} that faithfully preserves Image 1's face, ancestry traits, gender presentation, hair, eyes, complexion, costume, palette, proportions, and equipment. Do not import identity details from Image 2. {{equipmentRule}} Translate the portrait into the compact full-body quality and readable silhouette demonstrated by Image 2. Use a {{background}} background with no floor or scenery. Polished hand-authored 16-bit pixel art with crisp intentional pixel clusters, bold dark outlines, restrained warm top-left highlights, and muted watercolor-and-parchment color ramps. One centered full-body character in a neutral ready stance facing {{baseFacing}} with generous padding. {{invariants}}
promptTemplates.animation: Draw exactly {{frameCount}} genuinely redrawn full-body {{actionLabel}} poses of the authoritative {{displayName}} in a {{columns}}-column by {{rows}}-row atlas, ordered top row left-to-right and then bottom row left-to-right. Player identity metadata: {{visualTraits}}. Required sequence: {{frameSequence}}. Motion direction: {{motionDirection}}. Overall wizard motion is {{motionStyle}}. {{poseRequirement}} Preserve the exact portrait identity, costume, palette, proportions, and equipment throughout. {{equipmentRule}} {{magicRule}} Action-specific effects: {{effectRule}} Use a {{background}} background with generous gutters between complete head-to-toe poses. {{invariants}}

idle.motionDirection: A quiet breathing loop with alternating weight shifts; the first and last poses connect smoothly.
idle.effectRule: Only a faint, identity-consistent magical pulse is permitted; no large spell effect.
frameDescriptions: inhale with shoulders and chest subtly raised
weight shift onto the forward leg with robe folds and free hand responding
inhale with staff hand, hair, and loose cloth subtly moving
weight shift onto the rear leg with distinct robe folds
gentle exhale flowing smoothly back to frame one

walk.motionDirection: A coherent alternating-contact walk loop with real leg compression, passing poses, opposite arm motion, and secondary cloth movement.
walk.effectRule: No active spell effect; any ambient focus glow remains small and consistent.
frameDescriptions: passing pose with left foot moving behind
passing pose with right foot moving behind
left foot reaching forward into the loop

attack.motionDirection: Clear anticipation, planted step, forceful staff sweep or thrust, impact, follow-through, recoil, and recovery.
attack.effectRule: A compact identity-colored magical impact may appear at contact but must not conceal the attacking limbs or staff.
frameDescriptions: rear foot planted and staff or focus pulled back
deep windup with shoulders and free arm engaged
forward step beginning a forceful sweep or thrust
full impact with staff and casting arm extended
follow-through with robe and hair momentum

hurt.motionDirection: Articulated impact flinch, maximum stagger, stumbling recoil, equipment brace, guarded recovery, and return to balance.
hurt.effectRule: A small disrupted ward or scattered magical sparks may appear; no gore, blood, or full-body tint.
frameDescriptions: sharp flinch with defensive free arm
maximum stagger with knees bent and equipment arm thrown back
stumbling backward while retaining the wizard focus
bracing with the staff or grounded stance

death.motionDirection: Loss of balance, buckling knees, kneeling, sideways collapse, ground contact, settling, and an unmistakable final fully fallen rest pose.
death.effectRule: Any magic fades as the character falls. No gore or dismemberment, and never rigidly rotate the upright sprite.
frameDescriptions: fatal impact and loss of balance
knees buckle and held equipment slips

cast.motionDirection: Focus planting, free-hand rise, energy gathering, two-arm channeling, maximum buildup, forceful release, follow-through, and composed finish.
cast.effectRule: Build and release a compact spell in the identity's magical palette; effects must not hide anatomy or equipment mechanics.
frameDescriptions: staff or focus planted and free hand raised
focus sweeps upward while gathering magical energy
wide stance channeling with both arms

dead.prompt: Deterministically repeat the accepted terminal death frame eight times; do not generate a second corpse identity.

victory.motionDirection: Realization, raised free hand and focus, joyful hop, equipment flourish, side dance step, celebratory turn, broad flourish, and a held triumphant finish.
victory.effectRule: Small celebratory magical accents are permitted but must remain secondary to the dancing body and arm motion.
frameDescriptions: free fist and staff or focus raised
celebratory turn with open free hand
